curl.name: vendor_lookup
curl.description: Find certificate references for a vendor from the split vendor index.
curl.command: curl -s https://kfcain.github.io/nist-cmvp-api/api/indexes/vendors.json | jq '.keys["Intel Corporation"][] | {certificate_number, module_name, path, status}'

curl.name: module_lookup
curl.description: Search module names in the compact certificate index.
curl.command: curl -s https://kfcain.github.io/nist-cmvp-api/api/certificates/index.json | jq '.certificates[] | select(.module_name | test("OpenSSL"; "i")) | {certificate_number, vendor_name, module_name, path}'

curl.name: algorithm_lookup
curl.description: Find certificates whose extracted algorithm categories include AES.

curl.name: status_lookup
curl.description: List active certificates from the status index.

python.name: vendor_modules
python.code:
import requests
vendor_index = requests.get('https://kfcain.github.io/nist-cmvp-api/api/indexes/vendors.json', timeout=30).json()
for cert in vendor_index['keys'].get('Intel Corporation', []):
    print(cert['certificate_number'], cert['module_name'], cert['path'])

python.name: fetch_certificate_detail
python.code:
import requests
index = requests.get('https://kfcain.github.io/nist-cmvp-api/api/certificates/index.json', timeout=30).json()
match = next(cert for cert in index['certificates'] if 'OpenSSL' in (cert.get('module_name') or ''))
detail = requests.get('https://kfcain.github.io/nist-cmvp-api' + match['path'], timeout=30).json()
print(detail['certificate']['vendor_name'], detail['certificate']['algorithms'])
